reach: Corrected reach (2026-10-20, tests/n06_cutout_reach_45.rs, Java at a773a70ec read for the same chain): the two switches live in Simplex::cutout_from (Simplex.cutoutFrom), which a cutout reaches when either shape is a simplex (TileShape::cutout_counted, tile_shape.rs; Java IntBox.cutoutFrom(Simplex) and IntOctagon.cutoutFrom(Simplex) convert themselves with toSimplex). The 45 degree search tree (ShapeSearchTree45Degree.calculateTreeShapes for drill items, obstacle areas and the outline, :510-563) keeps bounding octagons for those items but takes trace shapes from the base class (ShapeSearchTree.calculateTreeShapes(PolylineTrace), :1120-1131, Polyline.offsetShapes, :358-512), which simplifies to an octagon only when every line is a multiple of 45 degrees (Simplex.simplify / isIntOctagon, :60-70, :365-379). So a trace with a line off 45 degrees keeps a simplex tree shape on a 45 degree board: fixed or protected any-angle wiring of the loaded board (canary-pwr: 5 fixed segments, 6 simplex tree shapes; Issue756-tomu-fpga8: 140 traces, 147 shapes) or a router-made trace whose line is off by a unit (amendment 2's canary-pwr baseline SES has one, B.Cu 1500, (1160960,-544113) to (1157596,-540750)). A drill page (DrillPage.getDrills, :63-103; drills.rs page_cutouts and calculate_page_drills) holding such a shape gets a simplex hole; every piece that hole cuts is a simplex, so the page's later octagon holes go through Simplex.cutoutFrom too. The tie-pin cutout (ShapeSearchTree.reduceTraceShapeAtTiePin, :935-965; MazeSearchEngine.java:166-178; BasicBoard::reduce_trace_shape_at_tie_pin) reaches it when such a trace ends at a pin of more than one net (0 such pins on the rows checked). Computing every drill page of one net's session at load: canary-pwr 460 pages, 5 with a simplex shape, reach (0, 14); tomu-fpga8 448 pages, 40 with a simplex shape, reach (33, 701); J2 84 pages, no simplex shape, reach (0, 0); no page without a simplex tree shape reaches either switch. A run reaches only the pages its maze search computes: amendment 2's tomu-fpga8 computed no drill (drills_computed 0) and tomu-fpga9 2695 drills with both counters 0. The 90 degree tree keeps boxes only (offsetBox, bounding boxes), so it never reaches them. The stored areas' splits (search-tree area shapes and the other Area splits, not counted per run) reach cutout_hole_crosses_border on tomu-fpga8 (12) and tomu-fpga9 (8), the corpus inventory's only boards

metric_definitions.via_in_pad: no new breach versus baseline (option (b), N06.4 amendment 2): an arm's count of vias in an SMD pad that the input has no via with that centre, padstack and nets for, minus the baseline arm's count on the same row, floored at 0; raw count via_in_pad_raw; plugin canary: tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py on the imported board
metric_definitions.below_minimum: no new breach versus baseline (option (b)): on a DSN row, the arm's delivered traces narrower than the board's narrowest class width that the input board does not already have, minus the baseline arm's number on the same row, floored at 0 (the router's pin neck-down puts copper under every class width by design, so the baseline breaks the raw count); raw count below_minimum_raw, and below_class_width_nets (freerouting-dev widths, under_mm > 0) reported, neither judged; plugin canary: KiCad's track_width errors minus the baseline arm's, floored at 0
metric_definitions.clearance_violations: DSN rows: the router's clearance violations of the final board (result.json board_statistics; gate collect's clearance_violations); a guard, no new breach versus baseline: the arm's count is not above the baseline arm's on the same row
metric_definitions.drc_real: plugin canary only: KiCad error-severity items other than unconnected items; a guard, no new breach versus baseline: the arm's count is not above the baseline arm's
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: plugin canary only: KiCad's unconnected items after the import (canary grade.sh); the totals signal where it is a number
metric_definitions.unrouted: gate collect's unrouted (connections.incomplete_count) of the final board; the totals signal of the DSN rows, which have no KiCad board
metric_definitions.session_differences: n06_run.py: 1 when the arm's SES differs from the baseline's
metric_definitions.cutout_hole_crosses_border_reached: STATS total.counts.cutout_hole_crosses_border_reached: the simplex cutout pieces (drill pages and the tie-pin cutout) whose first-division-line clip differs between the two values of the switch, counted in both arms
metric_definitions.simplex_octagon_half_corner_reached: STATS total.counts.simplex_octagon_half_corner_reached: the simplex cutout corners (drill pages and the tie-pin cutout) that are not integer points and lie on no outer border line, counted in both arms
metric_definitions.octagon_box_cutout_branch3_reached: STATS total.counts.octagon_box_cutout_branch3_reached (N06.4's counter); the key is true in every arm, so this only reports how often Java's branch 3 runs
metric_definitions.simplex_prev_division_line_reached: STATS total.counts.simplex_prev_division_line_reached (N06.4's counter); the key is false in every arm
metric_definitions.any_angle_room_side_mismatches: STATS total.counts.any_angle_room_side_mismatches (N06.16's counter); the key is false in every arm
